category5.design: The injected code inverts the inflate result test in bgzf_uncompress (`== Z_STREAM_END`), so the vulnerable build reports 'Inflate operation failed' on every valid BGZF block while the secure build decompresses it. It is a behavioural bug with no crash, so the oracle matches the project's own error message (printed only by the vulnerable build); the PoC is a data file (no argv it controls).
